result.milestoneDay25Desc: Vet can confirm pregnancy via ultrasound starting around day 25.
result.milestoneDay45Desc: X-ray shows fetal skeletons clearly. Count puppies and verify positioning.
result.milestoneDay58: Day 58 — Possible early labor; start temperature monitoring
result.milestoneDay58Desc: Begin daily temperature monitoring. A drop below 37.8°C (100°F) signals labor within 24 hours.
result.milestoneDay60Desc: Nesting behavior intensifies. Ensure the whelping area is fully prepared.
result.milestoneDay63Desc: Expected whelping date. Most dogs deliver on or near day 63.
result.milestoneDay65: Day 65 — Late term; contact vet if no labor
result.milestoneDay65Desc: If no signs of labor, consult your veterinarian for assessment.
result.milestoneDay68Desc: Latest safe boundary. Contact your veterinarian immediately if labor has not started.
